allowClear.zh-CN: 是否允许再次点击后清除。
allowClear.en-US: Whether clicking the selected star again clears the value.

allowHalf.en-US: Whether half stars can be selected.

character.zh-CN: 每颗星中绘制的字符，可传入 JSX 元素，如 `<IconLikeHeart />`，未设置时为星形图标。传入纯文本字符串时，该文本作为各星可访问名称与整组摘要的单位。
character.en-US: Character drawn in every star, a JSX element such as `<IconLikeHeart />`; the star icon when not set. When it is a plain text string, that text is the unit in each star's accessible name and the group summary.

disabled.zh-CN: 只读，无法进行交互，也无法获得焦点。
disabled.en-US: Read-only: no interaction and no focus.

name.zh-CN: 不生效：radiogroup 不能带 name，传入的值被丢弃。
name.en-US: Ineffective: a radiogroup cannot carry a name, so the value is dropped.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个评分组件时的回调，在星之间移动不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the whole rating; moving between stars does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 选择变化时的回调，参数为新的值。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the new value.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击星或按 Enter、Space 选中时的回调，参数为事件与星的序号；不会作为根元素的原生 click 监听。
onClick.en-US: Called when a star is clicked or selected with Enter or Space, with the event and the star index. It is not a native click listener on the root element.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入整个评分组件时的回调，在星之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the whole rating; moving between stars does not call it.

onHoverChange.zh-CN: 指针经过时数值变化的回调；指针移出或点击清除时参数为 `undefined`。
onHoverChange.en-US: Called when the hovered value changes; receives `undefined` when the pointer leaves or a click clears the value.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 仅在方向键使值移动时的回调。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called only for an arrow key that moved the value.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the component.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 指示浏览器是否应滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，作用于组件内的聚焦。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser should avoid scrolling the document to show the newly focused element, for focus inside the component.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small，也可传入 number 自定义尺寸。
size.en-US: Size: default or small, or a number for a custom size.

value.zh-CN: 当前受控值，传入后由该值决定显示；变回 undefined 时回到 defaultValue 并转为非受控。
value.en-US: Controlled value. When given, this value decides what is shown; back to undefined it returns to defaultValue and becomes uncontrolled.
